newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: OMV TALKS WITH NESTE ON.
newsitem.headline: OMV TALKS WITH NESTE ON.

text.p: Austrian oil and chemicals group OMV AG is negotiating to buy 50 percent of Danish petrochemical firm Borealis A.S. from Finland's Neste Oy, a newspaper reported on Thursday.
Daily Salzburger Nachrichten said the takeover would be engineered by OMV shareholder International Petroleum Investment Company (IPIC) and OMV.
OMV would not need a capital increase to finance the deal because, following the acquisition, OMV subsidiary Petrochemie Danubia (PCD) would be merged into Borealis, the paper said.
IPIC owns 19.6 percent of OMV, while Austrian state holding company OeIAG holds 35 percent. Borealis is joint-owned by Neste and Norway's Statoil A.S.
OMV, Austria's largest industrial group, declined to comment on the report. OeIAG was unavailable for comment. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12256
